minecraft:particle_initialization.per_render_expression: variable.intro = math.hermite_blend(math.clamp(variable.particle_age / 0.4, 0, 1)); variable.outro = math.hermite_blend(math.clamp((variable.particle_lifetime - variable.particle_age) / 0.6, 0, 1)); variable.phase = math.mod(variable.particle_age + 0.45, 0.5); variable.beat = math.exp(-12 * variable.phase) + 0.55 * math.exp(-12 * math.max(variable.phase - 0.15, 0)) * (variable.phase >= 0.15); variable.spread = (1.4 - 0.4 * variable.intro) * (1 - 0.05 * variable.beat) * (1.3 - 0.3 * variable.outro);
